status: NON-GOVERNING study on the v0.5.6 baseline; the build is unchanged

today.note: from G5; no end fittings or node mounts are in the 35 t

design_compression_mpa.prov: ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: 400 MPa floor x 0.62 knockdown for impact damage, joints and environment (compression after impact)

splice_allowance.prov: ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: +10% on span mass for splices, ply drops and frame clips

min_wall_mm.prov: ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: minimum CFRP tube wall for handling and impact

ti_ftu_mpa.prov: PUBLISHED_PHYSICS: Ti-6Al-4V ultimate tensile strength ~900-950 MPa

fitting_factor.prov: ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: conventional lug/flange fitting, material ~2.5x the ideal (fitting factor 1.15 x load-spreading inefficiency)

fitting_length_m.prov: ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: load is transferred into the frame or cone over ~0.8 m

fitting_fixed_t.prov: ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: bolts, shims and inspection access per fitting

osteon_saving.prov: BUILDER-DERIVED (OST-22), grounded in 2026 topology-optimised metal brackets that save 30-60%: low / central / high

node_module_t.prov: ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: one field-node module; canon gives the plant (88 t) but not a node's mass

node_mount_t.prov: ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: conventional mount on the ring frame nearest the station, in the dry tank-skin gap, tied into the longeron; sized for alignment stiffness, not strength (the 5 g x 1.5 load is only ~15 kN)

node_hatch_t.prov: ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: flush external access hatch per node in the service band (replaces skin, so only the frame and seal count)

strake_housing_t.prov: ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: shallow root fairing per stowed strake, x 14-32.3

bay_corner_t.prov: ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: conventional doubler at each corner of the bay slot

side_load_g.prov: ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: the 0.5 g side load already used for the flight-deck columns

shear_centre_offset_m.prov: ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: offset between the mass line and the shear centre of the slotted section

cfrp_shear_allow_mpa.prov: ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: in-plane shear allowable, quasi-isotropic CFRP
